w: Housed in the Central Park building on Avenue Malick Sy, this archive traces to 1913, when it served French West Africa's colonial administration from Saint-Louis, moving to Dakar after 1958. It now holds two UNESCO Memory of the World collections - colonial-era documents and 1,515 early-1900s postcards.
s: Senegal's paper trail, UNESCO-stamped twice over
_facts: Collection traces to 1913 as the French West Africa colonial archive
Moved from Saint-Louis to Dakar after 1958; renamed Archives Nationales in 1962
Holds two UNESCO Memory of the World collections: AOF documentation (inscribed 1997) and 1,515 postcards (inscribed 2015)
Located in the Central Park building on Avenue Malick Sy
